description: AI API Service module handling role-based AI interactions, including chat functions with mentor, chatbot, instructor, manager, and admin, as well as quiz and assignment generation for instructors.

methods.name: chatWithAI
methods.description: Sends a message to the AI chat service with optional context, returns AI response.

methods.name: chatWithMentor
methods.description: Chats with AI Mentor, course-specific for learners.

methods.name: chatWithBot
methods.description: Chats with the global chatbot for platform help.

methods.name: chatWithInstructorBot
methods.description: Chats with instructor co-teacher AI bot.

methods.name: chatWithManagerBot
methods.description: Chats with manager performance strategist AI bot.

methods.name: chatWithAdminBot
methods.description: Chats with admin system architect AI bot.

methods.name: generateQuizQuestions
methods.description: Generates quiz questions for instructor preview, with extended timeout.

methods.name: generateAssignmentDescription
methods.description: Generates assignment problem statement for instructor preview, with extended timeout.
